sentences.text: Stardust -LRB- 2007 -RRB- is a film adaptation of the 1999 Neil Gaiman novel of the same name , Stardust .	Neil Gaiman	Neil Gaiman	Stardust	Stardust (novel)	film adaptation	film adaptation

The romantic fantasy adventure film was directed by Matthew Vaughn and co-written by Vaughn and Jane Goldman .	Matthew Vaughn	Matthew Vaughn	Jane Goldman	Jane Goldman	fantasy	fantasy	adventure	adventure

The film features an ensemble cast led by Claire Danes , Charlie Cox , Sienna Miller , Jason Flemyng , Mark Strong , Rupert Everett , Ricky Gervais , Robert De Niro , Michelle Pfeiffer and Peter O'Toole , with narration by Ian McKellen .	Claire Danes	Claire Danes	Charlie Cox	Charlie Cox	Sienna Miller	Sienna Miller	Jason Flemyng	Jason Flemyng	Mark Strong	Mark Strong	Rupert Everett	Rupert Everett	Ricky Gervais	Ricky Gervais	Robert De Niro	Robert De Niro	Michelle Pfeiffer	Michelle Pfeiffer	Peter O'Toole	Peter O'Toole	Ian McKellen	Ian McKellen	ensemble cast	ensemble cast
The film follows Tristan , a young man from the fictional town of Wall .
Wall is a town on the border of the magical fantasy kingdom of Stormhold .	fantasy	fantasy
Tristan enters the magical world to collect a fallen star to give to his girlfriend Victoria , in return for her hand in marriage .
He collects the star who , to his surprise , is a woman named Yvaine .
Witches and the Princes of Stormhold are also hunting for Yvaine .	Witches	Witches
Meanwhile Tristan tries to get her back to Wall with him before Victoria 's birthday , the deadline of her offer .
The film was released to positive reviews and grossed $ 135.6 million on a $ 70 million budget .
In 2008 , it won the Hugo Award for Best Dramatic Presentation , Long Form .

Stardust was released on DVD , Blu-ray , and HD DVD on December 18 , 2007 , by Paramount Home Entertainment .	Stardust	Stardust (novel)	DVD	DVD	Blu-ray	Blu-ray	HD DVD	HD DVD	Paramount Home Entertainment	Paramount Home Entertainment
